d:
Bihar ki rajdhani patna sthit hotal taj siti sentar men aayojit rajy stariy karyashala 'levrejing phri tred egriments (FTAs) - aautrich program' (Leveraging Free Trade Agreements - Outreach Programme) men samrat chaudhri shamil hue. yah mahatvapurn karyakram bihar sarkar ke udyog vibhag dvara kendriy vanijy evan udyog mantralay aur videsh vyapar mahanideshalay (DGFT) ke sahyog se aayojit kiya gaya tha.
Sabse teji se audyogikran karne vala rajy banane ka dohraya sankalp
